review_description: I had some previous quotes before Zac was referred to me by Solar Quotes. He provided an initial quote based on my requirements and followed that up with variations requested based on different asimus for the panels and different Kw ratings including estimates of production that enabled me to decide on the best return. He also provided suggestions on whether to remain with 3 phase or just go single phase and the financial and practical implication of micro vs a single inverter.Installation was a breeze. Zac was careful not to damage the roof (it was pretty muddy here when he did the install), tidied up and explained what he was doing.Follow up was great with the addition of a monitor system at a later date that was out of stock at time of install. Took his suggestion on not changing supplier quickly and he provided all the paperwork for the grid connection.

Zac replied to our quote request promptly and did a site inspection. He explained our options thoroughly and supplied a quote which outlined details clearly. He also supplied product information sheets for us. Installation was done promptly considering our previous smaller system had to be removed, all of these components were removed from site. All after sales information Was provided the next day in regard to warranties and documents to forward to our energy supplier.

Very happy with the installer. Very polite punctual and Helped organise the grid connections. Most helpful explaining how it all works. Would recommend Zac Power to anyone that is wanting Solar connected.

After a horror install gone wrong that we had removed, we engaged Zac for a replacement system.He was prompt, and friendly when he came to inspect the property before starting the quote and spent time asking what we wanted to achieve, what the options were and what he could suggest and then prepared a detailed quote. A total difference to our previous experience, all options were included and detailed in pricing, extra work that we discussed was detailed and quoted. The expected performance was detailed.He came buy the week before the install to look over the site and explain what would happen. The system was installed over a day and a half with care and precision, compered to the 5 hour rush job we experienced previously. Zac spent time with us explaining the Fronius Inverter panel, and the Solar Analytics software and is coming back in a week to review and follow up.This young man and his team were punctual, friendly, clean and professional at every point.We are extremely happy with the quality of the products that he supplied and the workmanship that went into preparing and uninstalling the equipment.

When presented with our requirements, there was no fluffy sales mumbo jumbo. Andrew knew exactly what we needed and the best configuration of our setup.He maximized our return on investment and helped us with the paperwork.The boys arrived on time and were polite and courteous.This is what tradesmen should be like.I would recommend AMAX Electrical to all my mates .... and often do!

Quoted two systems with alternative prices. Installation started on time but there was a problem ordering the solar panels so ran a little over projected finish time. Customer service was exceptionally good and system has been working well since day 1.
